checklist: nano --help: usage line and option table
not a tty: 'Standard input is not a terminal', rc 1, no file created
pty, new file: type two lines, ^O + Enter ('Write to File: new.txt', '[ Wrote 2 lines ]'), ^X exits 0; bytes compared
pty, existing file: '[ Read 2 lines ]', ^E + UTF-8 text, ^O + Enter, ^X; bytes compared
pty, modified buffer: ^X asks 'Save modified buffer?', n discards, file unchanged
